source_snapshot.policy: Latest means latest stable shown by these primary sources on this date; recheck before a release, retain prior pins and never silently downgrade.

coordination.owned_scope: New secure-transport files, TLS 1.3 backend/native fixture and this requirements contract.
peer_owned_scope: existing running VMs and disk images
coordination.integration_required: Share secure-transport artifacts and receipts with the established guest and app owners; do not overwrite peer-owned files.

goals: Working themes in the actual desktop and native controls with persistence.
Current Legcord/Discord, Signal and current open-source Office suites with real guest functionality.
Broad operation of modern applications and the Office family, including retained prior app targets.
Port existing source and selectively integrate pinned current libraries, preserving licenses and patches.
Preserve the project's full Windows API compatibility aspiration separately from application results.
broad_goals.scope_policy: These finite mandatory checks are minimum acceptance gates, not proof of every modern application or all suite features; expand a versioned app/feature matrix without dropping existing requirements.

evidence_policy.pass_policy: Require all applicable app and global gates to have reproducible GUEST_PASS receipts in the claimed execution domain; BLOCKED, NOT_RUN and FAIL remain incomplete. Do not hide security/feature changes behind launch flags.
evidence_policy.network_tests: Use controlled TLS endpoints and approved test accounts/counterparts; do not embed credentials or perform unapproved real-account messaging.

new_required_apps.name: Legcord
known_gaps: An official ia32 package exists, but NT loader/API, Electron multiprocess semantics, graphics, real Discord connectivity and guest functionality remain unverified for this artifact.
Published architecture labels have not been confirmed by this task's PE inspection.

new_required_apps.name: Signal Desktop
known_gaps: Official Windows builds and Electron 44.1.0 are x64/ARM64, so the Win98 x86 wrapper path cannot directly load the official target.
Latest-source x86 rebuilding, if pursued, is a separate port artifact with its own patches, hashes and native-module builds; no prior app version can satisfy this pin.
Linking, encrypted message storage, native module execution and calls remain unverified.

new_required_apps.name: LibreOffice

runtime.source_port_policy: Use the same 26.8.0 source revision and record all architecture/backport changes; exact dependencies must be pinned by the suite owner.

known_gaps: The current official Windows download offers x86-64/ARM64; x86 Win98 API shims alone cannot execute this official x64 installer/app payload.
Installer acceptance, source-port completeness, real document rendering, formulas, save/cold reopen and native dialogs remain unverified.

new_required_apps.name: ONLYOFFICE Desktop Editors

runtime.runtime_inventory: The exact bundled browser/CRT/native dependencies must be inventoried from this artifact by the suite owner; no version is guessed.

known_gaps: An official x86 portable artifact exists, but XP support does not establish Win98 support.
Bundled runtime loading, real native controls, format conversion, save/cold reopen and clean exit remain unverified.

unresolved_corpus_entries.note: Legcord/Discord functionality is required; a Legcord result does not establish the separate official Discord binary.
Keep the existing official 1.138.0 corpus pin until a newer official artifact is acquired and the acceptance matrix explicitly updated.

existing_implementation_snapshot.nature: Repository-document snapshot, not rerun by this task.
findings: Kernel64 direct UEFI/TCG and Win64 fixture guest evidence exist; the older Supervisor-only VMX blocker must not erase them.
Chromium 157 x64 startup and crashpad child execution are recorded, with later startup checks still failing before browser-function milestones; this is not a rendered browser pass.
Electron/VSCodium peer guest trials stop at load-time imports in the recorded E1 tree; exact missing imports are revision-specific and must be remeasured after merges.
NTWin32Wrapper9x PE32 preparation rejects PE32+; it cannot by itself execute official Signal/LibreOffice x64 payloads.
The NTWDDM theme painter and builtin theme files are source assets, not evidence of actual desktop/native-control persistence.
No new-app functional receipts, system-wide TLS 1.3 receipts or theme-integration pass are supplied by this contract.
Historical Notepad++ editing/save evidence and its Save As/shutdown failures remain separate; no full pass is promoted here.

checks.requirement: Capture the Windows 98 host identity, any companion Kernel64 domain identity, cold-boot receipt, CPU architecture, actual process execution domain and desktop presentation path; a Linux host or standalone Kernel64 run does not prove Windows 98 integration.
Run the pinned app entry point with its complete packaged data/native-module tree; capture loader errors, main and helper process identities, responsive actual app UI and the tested launch flags.
Enter and read back Korean text and Unicode emoji through real keyboard/IME, copy/paste and pointer interaction; verify focus and window resize without crashes.
Close through the application's normal UI, observe all owned helper processes exit, reject forced termination, crash dialogs and unhandled exceptions as a clean shutdown.
Shut down the guest normally, cold boot it, reopen the exact app artifact and verify the stored settings and app-specific saved data.
Select at least two supported themes from the actual guest settings UI; verify the desktop, title bars and controls change and still respond.
Exercise real native buttons, edits, menus, checkbox/radio controls, scrollbars and file dialogs in normal, hover, pressed, focused and disabled states where applicable; inspect pixels and behavior.
Save a selected theme, relaunch applications and cold boot the guest; verify the active persisted theme and repaint of new native controls.
Verify native chrome and each app's supported theme setting using actual Legcord, Signal and Office windows; record custom-rendered content separately from native control coverage.
Authenticate to Discord in the actual Legcord app with approved test credentials and verify the chosen conversation is usable; a login page alone is insufficient.
Send and receive unique test messages containing Korean and emoji with an approved test counterpart, and verify the counterpart receipt and reopened conversation.
Transfer a known fixture file both ways and compare its SHA-256 after download on the receiving side.
Establish and close a voice session with the approved test counterpart; verify microphone/speaker audio and preserve failures as unresolved features.
Normally close and relaunch, then cold reopen; verify authenticated state, settings, theme and conversation without a crash or forced reset.
Display a live QR code and complete desktop linking with an approved Signal mobile test device; merely rendering a QR image is insufficient.
Send and receive unique encrypted test messages containing Korean and emoji with an approved test counterpart; verify both endpoints and cold-reopened history.
Transfer a known file both ways and compare hashes; confirm the real libsignal and encrypted local database modules load and operate.
Establish and close a voice/video call using the app's supported UI and real RingRTC path; record unsupported devices/features rather than substituting a mock.
Cold reopen the same installation and verify linked-device state, message history, theme and successful further messaging with intact encrypted storage.
In each required suite, create/open a document with Korean, styled text and a table; edit and save DOCX and ODT, normally close, cold reopen both and inspect the edited content/layout.
In each required suite, edit a sheet with a formula and chart, trigger recalculation, save XLSX and ODS, cold reopen and verify formula values, chart and Korean cells.
In each required suite, edit a slide deck with Korean and images, run its slideshow, save PPTX and ODP, cold reopen and verify content and slide display.
Export the edited office fixtures to PDF, reopen the output independently and verify Korean text, pagination and chart/slide content.
Use actual New/Open/Save As dialogs and new destination paths; verify output files on guest storage. Existing-file save alone is insufficient.

From the guest transport client, connect to a controlled independent TLS server offering TLS 1.3 only; verify chain, hostname and validity, negotiate TLSv1.3, exchange and compare application payloads, and close normally.
Reject an otherwise valid peer chained to an untrusted root before releasing application payload to the caller.
Reject a peer whose SAN does not match the requested hostname; do not bypass hostname verification or count encryption-only success.
Reject an expired peer certificate against the documented guest clock and validity policy.
Reject a peer certificate with a future notBefore value against the same controlled clock.
Reject a corrupted chain signature or tampered encrypted record without delivering unverified application data.
With the client constrained to TLS 1.3, reject a server offering only TLS 1.2 and record the negotiated version on successful trials.

Run a separately built client through the actual supported OS public transport API/provider, with the same positive and negative certificate checks; a direct library fixture alone does not satisfy this gate.
Identify and test the transport implementation actually used by each network app; an OS provider success does not establish Electron/BoringSSL or Signal native-module compatibility.
Render a known local page, execute JavaScript, use real input, fetch a controlled HTTPS fixture through the app and close cleanly; loader progress and --dump-dom alone are separate milestones.
Discover actual packaged plugins, play a known audio/video fixture with visible video and audible audio, seek and close cleanly.
Create a new Korean/Unicode file, use Save As, reopen and edit it, save and close normally; preserve the historical shutdown/Save As gaps until retested.
In official VS Code and separately VSCodium, edit/save/cold reopen a fixture, run the integrated terminal and a supported extension; VSCodium is not an official VS Code pass.
In actual Windows 98 Trident browser validate HTML parsing, DOM mutations, CSS layout, events and Korean input against identified upstream fixtures and interactive pages.
Execute actual modern JavaScript and asynchronous browser APIs in the integrated Trident browser; record precise upstream revision and passed/failing conformance cases.
In actual integrated Trident browser validate, instantiate and execute real WebAssembly modules and JS/host imports; reject malformed modules and report the actual supported feature subset.
Fetch a controlled HTTPS fixture through the Trident browser network path with real TLS1.3 and negative certificate tests; direct backend/library execution does not count as browser HTTPS.

browser_engine_direction.target: Actual modern HTML5/DOM/CSS, WebAssembly and modern JavaScript functionality; user requests 2026 web standards
browser_engine_direction.strategy: Extend existing Trident-based browser, combine source ports with modern libraries; preserve separate Chromium/Electron app goals
